3 ways to solve a quadratic equation

back.en: Factorisation, completing the square, quadratic formula
back.bm: Pemfaktoran, penyempurnaan kuasa dua, rumus kuadratik

front.en: Forming an equation from roots α and β
front.bm: Membentuk persamaan daripada punca α dan β

back.en: x < p or x > q (outside the roots)
back.bm: x < p atau x > q (di luar punca)

back.en: Two distinct real roots — graph cuts the x-axis twice
back.bm: Dua punca nyata berbeza — graf memotong paksi-x di dua titik

back.en: Two equal real roots — graph touches the x-axis once
back.bm: Dua punca nyata sama — graf menyentuh paksi-x di satu titik

back.en: No real roots — graph does not meet the x-axis
back.bm: Tiada punca nyata — graf tidak bertemu paksi-x

back.en: a > 0: ∪ shape, minimum point. a < 0: ∩ shape, maximum point
back.bm: a > 0: bentuk ∪, titik minimum. a < 0: bentuk ∩, titik maksimum

back.en: f(x) = a(x − h)² + k; turning point (h, k); axis x = h
back.bm: f(x) = a(x − h)² + k; titik pusingan (h, k); paksi x = h

front.en: Axis of symmetry from general form
Effect of changing c in ax² + bx + c
front.bm: Kesan perubahan c dalam ax² + bx + c

back.en: Shifts the graph up or down (c is the y-intercept)
back.bm: Menganjak graf ke atas atau ke bawah (c ialah pintasan-y)
